verses.text: Moses and the elders of Israel told the people, “Keep all the commands I'm giving you today.
On the day you cross the Jordan into the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.

Once you've crossed, write every word of this law on the stones, so you can enter the land the LORD your God is giving you. It's a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your ancestors, promised you.
After you cross the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal as I'm telling you today, and coat them with plaster.
Build a stone altar there for the LORD your God. Don't use any iron tool on the stones.
Build the altar of the LORD your God out of uncut stones and offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
Make peace offerings, eat there, and celebrate in the presence of the LORD your God.
Write every word of this law clearly on the stones.”
Moses and the Levitical priests told all Israel, “Be quiet and listen, Israel! Today you've become the people of the LORD your God.
So listen to the LORD your God and follow the commands and laws I'm giving you today.”
That same day Moses gave the people these instructions.
“After you cross the Jordan, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin will stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people.
Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali will stand on Mount Ebal for the curse.
The Levites must call out in a loud voice to all the men of Israel,
‘Cursed is anyone who makes a carved or cast idol and sets it up in secret. A craftsman made it by hand, and the LORD detests it.’ All the people must answer, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who dishonors their father or mother.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who moves their neighbor's boundary marker.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who leads a blind person off course on the road.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who denies justice to a foreigner, a fatherless child, or a widow.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father's wife, because he dishonors his father's bed.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who has sex with any animal.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister, whether she's his father's daughter or his mother's daughter.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who kills their neighbor in secret.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’
‘Cursed is anyone who fails to uphold the words of this law by putting them into practice.’ All the people must say, ‘Amen.’”
